audit_items.proof_trace: The pre-condition check is absent: `createTempRegistrationInternal` does not query temp_registrations for an active (non-expired, is_used=false) record and reject. Instead, line 161 unconditionally deletes all `is_used: false` records for the card_id before inserting a new token — replacement, not rejection. The delete (L161) and insert (L168) are also non-atomic: two concurrent calls for the same card_id can each skip past cleanup and both insert valid tokens, since the unique index on (card_id, is_used, expires_at) allows rows with distinct expires_at values.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A legitimate user initiates registration at the kiosk (QR token generated); before they scan the QR with their phone, an attacker at the kiosk (or via direct POST to the Next.js server action endpoint) submits the same card_id — L161 deletes the live token and a new one is created, silently invalidating the legitimate user's pending registration.
